capabilities: : Style semantic links with type-specific badges
: Detect broken semantic links across the vault
disambiguation: Not a general memory aid; it is a semantic knowledge graph and bidirectional linking engine.
extras: Uses app.vault.getMarkdownFiles() to scan all Markdown files within your vault for Dead Link Watcher functionality.
intentEvidence: Build a semantic knowledge graph with bidirectional links and custom ontologies.
problem: Standard note linking lacks formal structure and automatic bidirectional relationship management, making complex knowledge graphs difficult to maintain.
summary: Minder Nexus is a semantic knowledge graph engine that allows users to define formal relationships and build structured ontologies within their Obsidian vault.
